title: FORGE Lab uses agentic tools to identify memory safety issues in Rust
contentSnippet:
Microsoft FORGE Lab researchers found memory-safety bugs in Rust's core and std libraries, including cases where safe Rust code can trigger undefined behavior. Using Hyenas, FORGE's frontier research version of codename MDASH, the team investigated three patterns of misplaced trust in unsafe code and what they reveal about Rust's safety guarantees.
The post FORGE Lab uses agentic tools to identify memory safety issues in Rust appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog.

title: Launching the Vite Ecosystem Fund
contentSnippet: Cloudflare is distributing the first $301,300 of the Vite Ecosystem Fund to open source projects and maintainers. The recipients were chosen by a panel of Vite stack core team members, including maintainers not employed by Cloudflare.

title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
contentSnippet: Learn how OpenAI’s Control Room tracks model workloads across our research infrastructure and can rapidly stop them when safety or security concerns arise.

title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
contentSnippet: Kuken Industries uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of cooling tower drawings. Engineers can find the drawing for a repair in 4.5 minutes, down from nearly an hour.

title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
